1 /**
2  * Strip-first portfolio rank.
3  * Ranks Strip projections only — never N-full-reads Faces.
4  * Full Face only for top-k drill-in or heal (callers pass drill separately).
5  *
6  * Unknown capacity floor: capacity=unknown → rank penalty + LITE bias flag;
7  * never silent green.
8  * Anti-starvation: negative_heartbeat + anti_starvation_age_days.
9  */
10 
11 import { toStripProjection } from './face-strip.mjs';
12 
13 /** Rank score penalty when capacity is unknown (stricter than zero). */
14 export const CAPACITY_UNKNOWN_PENALTY = 50;
15 
16 /** Base weight per starvation day. */
17 export const STARVATION_DAY_WEIGHT = 3;
18 
19 /** Boost when human_wait is not none. */
20 export const HUMAN_WAIT_BOOST = 40;
21 
22 /** Penalty when negative_heartbeat says no attention needed. */
23 export const NEGATIVE_HEARTBEAT_PENALTY = 80;
24 
25 /**
26  * Build a rank projection from a strip object or discovery hit.
27  * Never requires Face.
28  * @param {object} stripOrHit
29  * @returns {object|null}
30  */
31 export function stripProjectionForRank(stripOrHit) {
32   if (!stripOrHit || typeof stripOrHit !== 'object') return null;
33 
34   // Discovery hit already has projection
35   if (stripOrHit.projection && stripOrHit.strip) {
36     return {
37       ...stripOrHit.projection,
38       project_path: stripOrHit.project_path ?? stripOrHit.projection.project_path,
39       strip_source: stripOrHit.strip_source ?? stripOrHit.projection.strip_source,
40       face_loaded: false,
41     };
42   }
43 
44   if (stripOrHit.projection && !stripOrHit.strip) {
45     return { ...stripOrHit.projection, face_loaded: false };
46   }
47 
48   const strip = stripOrHit.strip ?? stripOrHit;
49   const proj = toStripProjection(strip, {
50     project_path: stripOrHit.project_path,
51     strip_source: stripOrHit.strip_source,
52   });
53   if (!proj) return null;
54   return { ...proj, face_loaded: false };
55 }
56 
57 /**
58  * Score a single Strip projection (no Face fields consulted).
59  * @param {object} projection
60  * @returns {{ score: number, flags: object, reasons: string[] }}
61  */
62 export function scoreStripProjection(projection) {
63   const reasons = [];
64   const flags = {
65     lite_bias: false,
66     capacity_unknown: false,
67     silent_green: false,
68     negative_heartbeat: false,
69     anti_starvation: false,
70     human_wait: false,
71   };
72 
73   let score = 100;
74 
75   const capacity = projection?.capacity === 'known' ? 'known' : 'unknown';
76   if (capacity === 'unknown') {
77     score -= CAPACITY_UNKNOWN_PENALTY;
78     flags.capacity_unknown = true;
79     flags.lite_bias = true;
80     flags.silent_green = false; // never silent green
81     reasons.push('capacity_unknown_penalty');
82     reasons.push('lite_bias');
83   }
84 
85   const age =
86     typeof projection?.anti_starvation_age_days === 'number'
87       ? projection.anti_starvation_age_days
88       : 0;
89   if (age > 0) {
90     score += age * STARVATION_DAY_WEIGHT;
91     flags.anti_starvation = true;
92     reasons.push(`anti_starvation_age_days=${age}`);
93   }
94 
95   const wait = projection?.human_wait;
96   if (wait && wait !== 'none') {
97     score += HUMAN_WAIT_BOOST;
98     flags.human_wait = true;
99     reasons.push('human_wait_boost');
100   }
101 
102   const nh = projection?.negative_heartbeat;
103   if (nh && nh.no_attention_needed === true) {
104     score -= NEGATIVE_HEARTBEAT_PENALTY;
105     flags.negative_heartbeat = true;
106     flags.silent_green = false;
107     reasons.push('negative_heartbeat_downrank');
108   }
109 
110   // Explicit: unknown capacity must never present as green/all-clear
111   let attention_color =
112     capacity === 'unknown'
113       ? 'amber'
114       : nh?.no_attention_needed
115         ? 'dim'
116         : score >= 100
117           ? 'attention'
118           : 'normal';
119 
120   // Hard floor: capacity=unknown can never surface as silent green
121   if (capacity === 'unknown') {
122     flags.silent_green = false;
123     flags.lite_bias = true;
124     if (attention_color === 'green' || attention_color === 'normal') {
125       attention_color = 'amber';
126     }
127   }
128 
129   return {
130     score,
131     flags,
132     reasons,
133     attention_color,
134     capacity,
135     /** Rank used Strip projection only — Face fields never consulted. */
136     face_consulted: false,
137   };
138 }

140 /**
141  * Rank portfolio from Strip projections only.
142  * @param {object[]} stripsOrHits discovery hits, strips, or projections
143  * @param {{ top_k?: number }} [opts]
144  * @returns {{ ok: true, ranked: object[], face_loads_for_rank: 0, top_k: number, drill_in_eligible: object[] }}
145  */
146 export function rankPortfolioStripFirst(stripsOrHits = [], opts = {}) {
147   const top_k = typeof opts.top_k === 'number' && opts.top_k > 0 ? opts.top_k : 3;
148   const items = Array.isArray(stripsOrHits) ? stripsOrHits : [];
149 
150   const ranked = [];
151   for (const item of items) {
152     const projection = stripProjectionForRank(item);
153     if (!projection) continue;
154     const scored = scoreStripProjection(projection);
155     ranked.push({
156       project_id: projection.project_id,
157       project_path: projection.project_path,
158       score: scored.score,
159       flags: scored.flags,
160       reasons: scored.reasons,
161       attention_color: scored.attention_color,
162       capacity: scored.capacity,
163       negative_heartbeat: projection.negative_heartbeat,
164       anti_starvation_age_days: projection.anti_starvation_age_days,
165       human_wait: projection.human_wait,
166       next_recommended: projection.next_recommended,
167       why_next: projection.why_next,
168       active_effort: projection.active_effort,
169       phase: projection.phase,
170       // Prove strip-first: rank path never marks Face as loaded
171       face_loaded: false,
172       face_required_for_rank: false,
173       projection,
174     });
175   }
176 
177   ranked.sort((a, b) => {
178     if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
179     const ap = a.project_id ?? a.project_path ?? '';
180     const bp = b.project_id ?? b.project_path ?? '';
181     return String(ap).localeCompare(String(bp));
182   });
183 
184   const drill_in_eligible = ranked.slice(0, top_k);
185 
186   return {
187     ok: true,
188     ranked,
189     face_loads_for_rank: 0,
190     face_required_for_rank: false,
191     top_k,
192     drill_in_eligible,
193     message:
194       'Portfolio rank used Strip projections only; full Face reserved for top-k drill-in or heal',
195   };
196 }

198 /**
199  * Whether a rank result ever required full Face load (should always be false).
200  * @param {object} rankResult
201  */
202 export function rankRequiredFullFace(rankResult) {
203   if (!rankResult || !Array.isArray(rankResult.ranked)) return false;
204   if (rankResult.face_loads_for_rank > 0) return true;
205   if (rankResult.face_required_for_rank) return true;
206   return rankResult.ranked.some((r) => r.face_loaded === true || r.face_required_for_rank === true);
207 }
